name: Mitsurugi Madoka
source:
The 77th student council president of Kuritani Girl's School. She's a quiet, serious girl with a strong sense of justice. She has a gentle nature and hates conspicuous things.

[Translated from [url=http://lilys.shining-star.jp/lilys/220_Summer_Story/index.html]official site[/url]]
